modelClaim.name: Kling 4.0
modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
Kling 4.0 Just Dropped! So lets test it out.

https://t.co/2sAqIbBSCa

I had some old 3.0 made and used the exact same image references and prompts to see the difference in 3.0 and 4.0.

The first video on both test were the 4.0 and the 2nd is 3.0 both at 1080p

***Kling Changed its set up on the main page when doing videos. It is a nice change and less complicated***

Prompt

1: Late afternoon fading toward dusk in Blackwood Forest.Endless North Georgia pine and oak forest stretches in every direction. The forest is completely wild and undeveloped, with no visible trails, roads, paths, markers, campsites, fences, or signs of human maintenance.The woman 📷runs alone through the woods.Begin with a high overhead shot looking down through the canopy before descending toward her.Cut to a handheld tracking shot behind her shoulder as she moves through dense woodland, weaving between pine trunks, stepping over roots and fallen branches, forcing her way through untouched forest undergrowth.She glances behind her while continuing forward.Cut to a low-angle shot from the forest floor as she rushes past.A crow suddenly bursts from a nearby tree and flies away.Cut to a wide shot revealing how small she is compared to the massive forest surrounding her.The camera slowly pulls back as she continues deeper into Blackwood. No slasher. No other humans.The forest is completely wild and undeveloped, with no visible trails, roads, paths, markers, campsites, fences, or signs of human maintenance.

2. Foggy early morning pine forest. A weathered moss-covered log cabin sits alone among tall trees📷.The camera slowly pushes forward along the dirt path toward the cabin door . The porch swing gently moves in the wind.Suddenly the cabin door bursts open.A frightened blonde woman 📷, dirty and bruised, wearing a torn white tank top and dark pants, stumbles out and falls onto the porch, half her body outside and legs still inside the doorway.She looks up toward the camera in terror and screams for help.From inside the cabin behind her , the Blackwood Slasher 📷 in a hooded black raincoat and mask slowly steps forward with an axe .He grabs her ankle and drags her violently back inside the cabin.The door slams shut.The camera remains still on the silent foggy cabin as the porch swing slowly moves.urns to silence. cinematic horror film style,slow push-in camera movement,realistic lighting,foggy forest atmosphere,tense suspense pacing,dramatic jump scare,realistic human motion
